params.query: SELECT c.n, c.veredicto, c.confianza, c.accion, c.pm_id, c.pm_titulo, c.pm_estado, c.pm_asignado, (SELECT t.fecha_limite FROM tareas t WHERE t.id=c.pm_id) AS pm_fecha, (SELECT t.completada_en FROM tareas t WHERE t.id=c.pm_id) AS pm_completada, c.ce_id, c.ce_titulo, c.ce_estado, c.ce_source, c.ce_proyecto, (SELECT ct.vence FROM cerebro_tareas ct WHERE ct.id=c.ce_id) AS ce_fecha, c.nota, c.merge, c.resuelta, c.resolucion, c.resuelta_en FROM cruce c ORDER BY c.n
